newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar rises from lows, but vulnerable to declines.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rises from lows, but vulnerable to declines.

text.p: 0452 GMT --*Dollar off earlier lows due to light short-covering by interbank traders in afternoon Tokyo, but remained vulnerable on downside, dealers said.
*Falls in Tokyo stocks, partial recovery in yen bond prices and vague rumours that some Japanese insurers in trouble lent support to dollar, said a European bank dealer.
*He said clear break of 122.50 yen may signal that dollar could go down to 121.80 yen.
*Dealers said some major Japanese exporters also moved to sell dollars, although volume not large.
